TEXT_DESCRIPTION_1: **Full-stack developer** from Baja California, Mexico. I build **web apps** and **cloud infrastructure**.

EXPERIENCE.title: Freelance Frontend Developer
EXPERIENCE.description: Building the booking site for a yacht and sport-fishing charter operator in Los Cabos, with Next.js and Strapi.

EXPERIENCE.title: Intern, Application Developer
description: Frontend feature work on DougallGPT and DougallEYE, a multibrand medical AI assistant built with React, TanStack Query, Redux Toolkit and Vite. Shipped a redesign to production and cut logout from 30 seconds to 5.
Built internal tooling for the team as well: Claude Code skills, automated build checks, and a Playwright report pipeline on AWS that delivers results into Google Chat.

EXPERIENCE.title: Automated Testing Trainee
EXPERIENCE.description: University-company trainee program in test automation. Built test suites and reusable utility libraries in Java with Selenium, RestAssured and TestNG, applying SOLID principles and the Page Object Model.

EXPERIENCE.title: Software Developer & Research Assistant
description: Sole developer of La Brújula del Autismo, a React Native rebuild of Blue Piece, a published autism screening platform that had aged out.
Ran it as a user-centered design process: interviews with 8 caregivers and 3 specialists, parent surveys at a local autism fair, and a software requirements specification written before any code.
Designed the PostgreSQL schema and the row-level security scoping each patient record to its caregiver, treating specialist and an admin.

EXPERIENCE.title: Competitive Programming Club Co-Founder
EXPERIENCE.description: Co-led the university competitive programming club. Mentored students and led problem-solving workshops, managed social media, and recorded video tutorials to support the learning process.

PROJECTS.title: Stilo
PROJECTS.description: Mobile app that builds outfits from your own clothes using AI. Includes a colorimetry module that finds your most flattering palettes, a RAG pipeline that turns plain-language prompts into coordinated outfits, and an interactive canvas for drag-and-drop editing.
PROJECTS.context: Co-Author & Lead Developer • Paper accepted at MexIHC 2026
contributions: Designed the recommendation pipeline that interprets prompts, finds matching clothes, and assembles outfits.
Built the multiplatform app with a custom drag-and-drop outfit canvas.
Provisioned cloud infrastructure on Azure using Terraform.

PROJECTS.title: NASA Explorer
PROJECTS.description: Search engine for NASA's space biology research. Ask questions in plain English and get answers with citations to real NASA publications.
PROJECTS.context: Team of 6 • 1st Place — NASA Space Apps Challenge 2025
contributions: Built the backend — chat, history, users, and RAG orchestration with Vertex AI.
Developed frontend features: interactive knowledge graph, article favorites, and chat integration.

PROJECTS.title: Awita
PROJECTS.description: IoT water monitor for regions where the supply is unreliable. An Arduino reads the tank level every minute, the dashboard shows it live, and email alerts fire before you run dry. It has been running on my family's tank for over a year.
contributions: Designed the full system — Arduino firmware, a Go Lambda for sensor ingestion, the NestJS API, and the React dashboard.
Trained an LSTM to forecast when the tank would empty, measured it against the latency it added, and switched it off.

OTHER_PROJECTS.title: Havi
OTHER_PROJECTS.description: Proactive banking copilot built in two days for the Hey Banco datathon. I built the mobile client: 8 screens, a shared component library, and a typed context layer that falls back to mock data when the backend is down.

OTHER_PROJECTS.title: Espyntar
OTHER_PROJECTS.description: Multiplayer Pictionary in C++. Up to 8 players draw and guess over raw TCP with a custom binary protocol.

OTHER_PROJECTS.title: 16-BDH
OTHER_PROJECTS.description: Educational RPG about the Battle of Puebla, built on a custom game engine in C with Raylib. Playable on desktop and web via Emscripten.
